This '''cantina''' was located on [[Phorliss]] and was owned by a [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] named [[Gorb Drig]]. Gorb Drig had intended to run this cantina together with [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Parent/Legends|son]], but his son had been killed in one of Houks' wars of conquest. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], soon after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] was briefly working in this cantina as a [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]], being on the run from [[Ysanne Isard]] and her people.
